sections.section_title: GPIO port x output data register (GPIOx_ODR) (x = A to H, N to Q)
sections.text_helper: Section 15.4.6 "GPIO port x output data register (GPIOx_ODR) (x = A to H, N to Q)" in chapter 15 (General-purpose I/Os (GPIO)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 796.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x14
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:0 ODy: Port x output data I/O pin y (y = 15 to 0)
These bits can be read and written by software.
Note: For atomic bit set/reset, OD bits can be individually set and/or reset by writing
toGPIOx_BSRR or GPIOx_BRR. Each bit is reserved and must be kept to reset value
when the corresponding I/O is not available on the selected package.
Successful read or write to ODy must be secure if SECy= 1 in GPIOx_SECCFGR, and must
be privileged if PRIVy = 1 in GPIOx_PRIVCFGR.
